jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer Intern (Dec 2026)
jobs.description: A 12-week, full-time summer program from early December 2025 to late February 2026. The role requires experience building and deploying machine learning models. Applicants should be currently enrolled and completing their studies between 2025 and mid-2026 and based in Australia or New Zealand with working rights. Requirements include excellent Computing and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) Fundamentals, comfort with Python, and the ability to conceive and translate statistical or machine learning models to practical, scalable solutions.

jobs.title: 大模型算法工程师【2026届实习生】(J67066)
jobs.description: 大语言模型研发的应用与算法研发工作，包括数据、训练、评测、推理部署等；前沿新兴的大模型技术探索研究，持续探索利用大模型能力赋能各业务场景；深度参与产品研发项目，和产品/研发同学密切配合。要求：2026届在校生，硕士及以上学历；具备扎实的NLP/机器学习算法基础，有大语言模型/多模态大模型相关的实践经验，包括但不限于Prompt工程/RAG/Agents/Post-training/RLHF等；熟悉主流的Transformer架构下主流模型，熟练掌握PyTorch/TensorFlow等主流机器学习框架

jobs.title: 【北斗】大模型算法工程师【校招/实习】
jobs.description: 大模型算法实习生主要参与大模型训练、微调、推理优化等相关研发工作，支持LongCat大模型项目落地。岗位基本要求包括：硕士及以上学历（博士优先），计算机、数学或统计学等相关专业；扎实的深度学习理论基础，精通主流深度学习框架（如Tensorflow、Pytorch），拥有大模型SFT、RAG、DPO/PPO等大模型实操经验优先；具备较强的coding能力，熟练使用Python/C++等语言。

jobs.title: 大语言模型应用算法实习生-豆包大模型
jobs.description: 成为研究型实习生在热爱的课题方向上探索大语言模型领域最具挑战的长期关键问题；寻找志同道合的伙伴自由组建课题小组享受充足的算力与数据资源支持；获得长周期的培养与成长以及大牛导师深度指导。研究方向包括优化创新RLHF算法训练效率与模型泛化能力、Long CoT技术的实现和应用、多模态大模型的Posttraining算法、构建高质量多领域的数据合成方法、以及探索LLM在情感对话创作等场景的应用。

jobs.title: 文心一言-大模型Agent算法实习生
jobs.description: Participating in Ernie core technology development, exploring and improving existing LLM-powered Agent technology, including instruction alignment, RLHF, model evaluation, and Agent mechanism research; Keeping up with cutting-edge large model technology and top-tier research papers, promoting implementation and deployment of algorithm strategies, solving practical problems in real scenarios, and supporting the company's core business.

jobs.title: 算法工程师-VLM训练-阿里巴巴2027届实习生
jobs.description: Design and implement long-term training strategies for multimodal alignment and fusion of text, images, and videos, controlling GPU clusters at the scale of tens of thousands of cards, coordinating the full chain of Pretrain/CPT/SFT/RLVR/RLHF, and conducting efficient distributed optimization of ultra-large parameter foundation models. Deeply explore underlying principles and technologies such as MoE sparsification, training algorithms and alignment paradigm innovation, interpretability and quality monitoring, multimodal reasoning, mRAG, million Token-level long text processing, and Agent & toolchain mechanisms.
